release_gates_additions: ds-01 + ds-02 must equal ds-03 (89 + 413 = 502 at authoring). Inclusion and exclusion partition the unrestricted population; any other relationship means a derived set was inverted, dropped, or double-counted.

ds-04 (store) must render no open-order count and no table for the question ds-01 (admin) answers with a table. Both halves are required: a failing ds-01 makes ds-04's denial vacuous, exactly as with rb-01/rb-04.

ds-08 (admin) must answer 682 while ds-08b (sales) renders no invoice table at all for the same question. ds-08b is the inner-plan half of fail-closed: the caller can see invoices but not the orders the ranking needs, and a table ranked by any other basis is a silent substitution, not a helpful fallback.

Any table answer whose plan carried a derived set must render the receipt scope span (ds-01, ds-02, ds-07, ds-08, ds-09, ds-10, ds-11). A restricted table with no membership sentence fails regardless of the count - it is the silent narrowing ADR 0073 forbids.
ds-11 must return 101, not 89. The two sets differ by two members; 89 means the inner plan's period was dropped and the all-time ranking was silently used.

oracle_sql_addendum:
-- ds-01 / ds-02 / ds-03: derived-set partition. Open = computed_status NEW or IN_PROGRESS
-- (the open_customer_orders measure). The ranked set is the product's invoiced_revenue:
-- SUM(items_total) on Invoice bills, one currency, ties on customer key ascending, never
-- wider than 10. ds-01 + ds-02 must equal ds-03.
SELECT 'ds-03  open orders (unrestricted)' AS oracle, COUNT(id) AS value
FROM ai_v1_bq_order_fact WHERE entity_id = 1 AND computed_status IN ('NEW','IN_PROGRESS')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ds-01  open orders, top 10 customers by invoiced revenue (TZS)', COUNT(id)
FROM ai_v1_bq_order_fact
WHERE entity_id = 1 AND computed_status IN ('NEW','IN_PROGRESS')
  AND customer_id IN (
      SELECT customer_id FROM (
          SELECT customer_id, SUM(items_total) AS revenue
          FROM ai_v1_bq_bill_fact
          WHERE entity_id = 1 AND type = 'Invoice' AND currency_code = 'TZS' AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY customer_id
          ORDER BY revenue DESC, customer_id ASC
          LIMIT 10
      ) ranked)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ds-02  open orders, outside the top 10 by invoiced revenue (TZS)', COUNT(id)
FROM ai_v1_bq_order_fact
WHERE entity_id = 1 AND computed_status IN ('NEW','IN_PROGRESS') AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
  AND customer_id NOT IN (
      SELECT customer_id FROM (
          SELECT customer_id, SUM(items_total) AS revenue
          FROM ai_v1_bq_bill_fact
          WHERE entity_id = 1 AND type = 'Invoice' AND currency_code = 'TZS' AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY customer_id
          ORDER BY revenue DESC, customer_id ASC
          LIMIT 10
      ) ranked);

-- ds-01 members: the ten names the rendered rows must stay inside (ds-02 must avoid them).
-- Also prove there is no tie at rank 10/11 - a tie would make the membership depend on the
-- customer-key rule, which the browser cannot see.
SELECT 'ds-01  ranked member' AS oracle, customer_id, customer_name, ROUND(SUM(items_total), 2) AS revenue
FROM ai_v1_bq_bill_fact
WHERE entity_id = 1 AND type = 'Invoice' AND currency_code = 'TZS' AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY customer_id, customer_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC, customer_id ASC
LIMIT 11;

-- ds-05: the bare 'top customers' readings. Orders count has no tie at 10/11. Open customer
-- orders ties (11 = 11) and the value assumes customer key ascending.
SELECT 'ds-05  open orders, top 10 customers by orders count' AS oracle, COUNT(id) AS value
FROM ai_v1_bq_order_fact
WHERE entity_id = 1 AND computed_status IN ('NEW','IN_PROGRESS')
  AND customer_id IN (
      SELECT customer_id FROM (
          SELECT customer_id, COUNT(id) AS n FROM ai_v1_bq_order_fact
          WHERE entity_id = 1 AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY n DESC, customer_id ASC LIMIT 10
      ) ranked)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ds-05  open orders, top 10 customers by open customer orders (tie at 10/11)', COUNT(id)
FROM ai_v1_bq_order_fact
WHERE entity_id = 1 AND computed_status IN ('NEW','IN_PROGRESS')
  AND customer_id IN (
      SELECT customer_id FROM (
          SELECT customer_id, COUNT(id) AS n FROM ai_v1_bq_order_fact
          WHERE entity_id = 1 AND computed_status IN ('NEW','IN_PROGRESS') AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY n DESC, customer_id ASC LIMIT 10
      ) ranked);

-- ds-07: complete-mode set - every customer with an unpaid invoice (the invoices_unpaid
-- filter, outstanding > 0), no ranking, no limit. The member count (284) is the wrong-grain
-- answer and must not appear.
SELECT 'ds-07  open orders, customers with an unpaid invoice' AS oracle, COUNT(id) AS value
FROM ai_v1_bq_order_fact
WHERE entity_id = 1 AND computed_status IN ('NEW','IN_PROGRESS')
  AND customer_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM ai_v1_bq_bill_fact
                      WHERE entity_id = 1 AND type = 'Invoice' AND outstanding > 0 AND customer_id IS NOT NULL)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ds-07  customers with an unpaid invoice (must NOT be the answer)', COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id)
FROM ai_v1_bq_bill_fact
WHERE entity_id = 1 AND type = 'Invoice' AND outstanding > 0 AND customer_id IS NOT NULL;

-- ds-08: unpaid invoices (outstanding > 0) for the top 10 customers by orders count. The
-- ranking lives on customer_order, the rows on invoice. ds-08b (sales) must refuse this.
SELECT 'ds-08  unpaid invoices, top 10 customers by orders count' AS oracle, COUNT(id) AS value
FROM ai_v1_bq_bill_fact
WHERE entity_id = 1 AND type = 'Invoice' AND outstanding > 0
  AND customer_id IN (
      SELECT customer_id FROM (
          SELECT customer_id, COUNT(id) AS n FROM ai_v1_bq_order_fact
          WHERE entity_id = 1 AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY n DESC, customer_id ASC LIMIT 10
      ) ranked)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ds-08  unpaid invoices, unrestricted (must NOT be the answer)', COUNT(id)
FROM ai_v1_bq_bill_fact WHERE entity_id = 1 AND type = 'Invoice' AND outstanding > 0;

-- ds-09: jobs (no department predicate for admin) for customers with an invoice more than
-- 30 days overdue - the product's invoices_overdue_unpaid filter. Every unpaid invoice in
-- this snapshot is at least 45 days past due, so the set equals ds-07's; re-check the MIN.
SELECT 'ds-09  jobs, customers with an invoice over 30 days overdue' AS oracle, COUNT(id) AS value
FROM ai_v1_bq_job_fact
WHERE entity_id = 1
  AND customer_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM ai_v1_bq_bill_fact
                      WHERE entity_id = 1 AND type = 'Invoice' AND days_past_due IS NOT NULL
                        AND days_past_due > 30 AND outstanding > 0 AND customer_id IS NOT NULL)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ds-09  minimum days_past_due on an unpaid invoice (must stay above 30)', MIN(days_past_due)
FROM ai_v1_bq_bill_fact WHERE entity_id = 1 AND type = 'Invoice' AND outstanding > 0;

-- ds-10: customers with a quotation but no order. Two sets, or one set plus has_orders.
-- The three wrong answers are each half of the question and the whole customer count.
SELECT 'ds-10  customers with a quotation and no order' AS oracle, COUNT(id) AS value
FROM ai_v1_bq_customer_fact
WHERE entity_id = 1
  AND id IN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM ai_v1_bq_bill_fact
             WHERE entity_id = 1 AND type = 'Quotation' AND customer_id IS NOT NULL)
  AND id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM ai_v1_bq_order_fact
                 WHERE entity_id = 1 AND customer_id IS NOT NULL)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ds-10  customers with a quotation (must NOT be the answer)', COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id)
FROM ai_v1_bq_bill_fact WHERE entity_id = 1 AND type = 'Quotation' AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ds-10  customers without orders (must NOT be the answer)', SUM(has_orders = 0)
FROM ai_v1_bq_customer_fact WHERE entity_id = 1;

-- ds-11: the inner plan carries its own period. Top 10 by invoiced revenue in 2024, then
-- open orders today. Must differ from ds-01 (all-time set): 101 vs 89 at authoring.
SELECT 'ds-11  open orders, top 10 customers by invoiced revenue in 2024' AS oracle, COUNT(id) AS value
FROM ai_v1_bq_order_fact
WHERE entity_id = 1 AND computed_status IN ('NEW','IN_PROGRESS')
  AND customer_id IN (
      SELECT customer_id FROM (
          SELECT customer_id, SUM(items_total) AS revenue
          FROM ai_v1_bq_bill_fact
          WHERE entity_id = 1 AND type = 'Invoice' AND currency_code = 'TZS' AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
            AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
          GROUP BY customer_id
          ORDER BY revenue DESC, customer_id ASC
          LIMIT 10
      ) ranked);
SELECT 'ds-11  ranked member 2024' AS oracle, customer_id, customer_name, ROUND(SUM(items_total), 2) AS revenue
FROM ai_v1_bq_bill_fact
WHERE entity_id = 1 AND type = 'Invoice' AND currency_code = 'TZS' AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
  AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY customer_id, customer_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC, customer_id ASC
LIMIT 11;
